notes.title: Patch incoming!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we wanted to share a quick update regarding our development since the release. First off, thanks so much to everyone for download and playing our game. We did not expect this amount of attention for a student game that we made, but we are incredibly thankful! 

Over the past week we have been working on make the game more stable, and implementing some quality of life features. We have a bunch planned and cant wait to release the update this week! 

Including, but not limited to:

Fov Slider

VSync toggle

Damage indicator

20+ achievements

Improved collision

Improved enemy navigation

Improved wave balancing

Resolved input issues

And more!



If you are (or have) run into issues while playing our game, we kindly ask for you to head over to our Discord server so we can assist you further and help resolve the issue.

Thanks again to everyone who played! See you soon :)
